texts: Mitral insufficiency is not a typical late problem among long-term survivors of tetralogy repair: A.

The late problems are on the right side: pulmonary regurgitation and right ventricular dilation and dysfunction, residual or recurrent pulmonary stenosis, atrial and ventricular arrhythmias and sudden death.
These patients need lifelong follow-up, and many later need pulmonary valve replacement.
In the picture, years later the mitre stays shut, while the weak blue fan, the pirate, the narrowing and the coffin gather on the blue side.
Memory hook: after the Tetris repair, the trouble lives on the blue side.
